definitions.explanation: To a great extent or degree. Used to emphasize the magnitude of something.

examples.japanese: {大|おお}いに{助|たす}かりました。
{大|おお}いに{期待|きたい}しています。
{大|おお}いに{反省|はんせい}しています。

notes:
{大|おお}いに is a formal adverb meaning greatly or very much.

POSITION: Usually placed before the verb.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {大|おお}いに{役立|やくだ}つ (be very useful)
- {大|おお}いに{楽|たの}しむ (enjoy greatly)
- {大|おお}いに{賛成|さんせい}する (strongly agree)
- {大|おお}いに{結構|けっこう} (quite all right, perfectly fine)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- とても: very (neutral)
- {大|おお}いに: greatly (formal, emphatic)
- {非常|ひじょう}に: extremely (formal)

[Register: Formal]
